items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: Lawrence Morrell on the banjo, and I was on the drum.

ctx.x: And the Pack House that was located on the court had the restaurant and ball and pool table downstairs. They called it, they was run by this fella by the name of Faubacher. And this fella, Bebe, William Ridgely's brother, he was the manager of the place. I think I don't know, remember his name? His first name? Yeah, his first name was Bebe Ridgely, his first name, he was a big tall, brown skin, heavy built man. But he was the manager of that place there, I can't think of his first name. But all I can tell you,…
What's the name of that band?

items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: Lawrence Morrell... we had Raymond Brown first, trombone player. Oh yeah. Myself on the drum. And we named that band. First the name we had called it, called it the Golden Rules, uh, Jazz Band... Lawrence was manager, Bush Hall was leader.

ctx.x: Why'd you come to go to that Cincinnati thing with Lawrence?

Well, that was, the people wanted Lawrence up there. They knew Lawrence from George Lewis' band. Oh, yeah. The Rosenthal's family. Yeah. His name is, he's crazy about George Lawrence. Yeah. George Rosenthal. People out in Cincinnati. Lawrence got the job, did he? Lawrence got the job and we made that Cincinnati trip.
What was that band called? Hmm? What was it called?
